name: show_tag
label: Show topic tag
help_text: Uses the first HubSpot blog tag/topic assigned to the post. If no post tag exists, the fallback tag below can be shown.

name: show_fallback_tag
label: Show fallback tag if post has no tag

name: fallback_tag_slug
label: Fallback tag slug / colour style
help_text: Also controls the tag colour style. Examples: industry-news, technical, standards, technology, training, advocacy, member-news.

name: summary_override
label: Hero summary override
help_text: Optional. Leave blank to use the blog post meta description / summary.

name: background_image
label: Article hero image override
help_text: Optional image used only in this article hero. Leave blank to use the blog post Featured image. To change the thumbnail shown on the News page and homepage, update Settings > Featured image on the blog post.
